item.title: Netanyahu says Iran can no longer enrich uranium or manufacture ballistic missiles
item.description: Netanyahu said Israel would hold off on any further attacks on Iran’s giant South Pars natural gas field at Trump’s request, following earlier strikes that heightened tensions in global energy markets

item.title: US plans to ease sanctions on Iranian oil; Israeli officials say attack on Iranian gas field won't happen again
item.description: Amid global energy crisis, US Treasury Secretary announced plans to lift sanctions imposed on Iranian oil: 'about 140 million barrels, up to two weeks' supply'; after Trump disavowed Israeli attack on Iran gas field, sources in Jerusalem emphasized it was coordinated

item.title: Israel strikes Tehran as Iran launches missiles toward north
item.description: Air defenses activated across Gulf states as Iranian launches trigger sirens in Haifa and beyond; alerts issued only for Golan and front-line areas, raising questions after no prior warning in several northern communities

item.title: US F-35 fighter jet hit by Iranian fire, makes emergency landing
item.description: US Central Command confirms the plane made an emergency landing at a US military base, and said the pilot is in stable condition; incident, which is under investigation, marks first time Iran has hit an American or Israeli plane since start of war

item.title: Damage at Haifa oil refineries after Iranian missile attack
item.description: Strike caused damage at Bazan oil refineries, sparked fire and hazardous materials assessment, knocked out power in parts of the city and lightly injured one person, as Iran claimed retaliation for Israeli strikes on South Pars gas facilities

item.title: Israel takes on larger share of strikes from US in Iran, data shows
item.description: More than 15,000 targets have been struck by the IDF and US forces, with over 50 senior Iranian officials killed and major damage reported to missile, air defense and naval capabilities, including key gas infrastructure in southern Iran

item.title: Israeli Air Force strikes Iranian naval vessels in Caspian Sea for first time
item.description: Iranian opposition reports say attacks hit port city of Bandar Anzali, home to headquarters of Iranian navy’s Northern Fleet district, marking a major expansion of the war’s geographic scope

item.title: "גם אם המלחמה עם איראן היא אינטרס פוליטי של נתניהו — היא עדיין נכונה"
item.description: האיחוד האירופי? "מציית לחוק הבינלאומי, ומשהו בו כנראה פגום". השמאל העולמי? "הפך לפסימי, ולא מצליח לייצר תחושות של סולידריות ואהבה". הביקורת על ישראל? "עברנו לאנטישמיות על רקע פוליטי. אין בעולם אידיאולוגיה לאומית שנואה כמו הציונות". פרופ' אווה אילוז, מן הסוציולוגיות הבכירות ביש...

item.title: Israeli teacher in reserves keeps teaching students from Lebanon combat zone
item.description: An IDF paramedic and high school educator, serving nearly 400 days in reserves, continues teaching his students over Zoom from combat zones in Lebanon and Syria, saying the bond gives strength to both sides and keeps the next generation grounded
